summary: This is a list-style wiki page covering characters from the ABC television series Once Upon a Time, drawn from a clipped Wikipedia article. It describes the series finale 'Leaving Storybrooke' in which Rumple sacrifices his heart to save Captain Hook, and profiles Henry Mills, Captain Killian 'Hook' Jones, and Robin of Locksley/Robin Hood, including the actors who portrayed them and how their roles changed over seasons.
one_line: Catalog of characters from the ABC series Once Upon a Time, with actor casting and character background notes.
key_facts: Rumple sacrifices his heart in the series finale 'Leaving Storybrooke' to save Captain Hook from the Wish Realm.
Upon Rumple's death, Belle appears to him on Mount Olympus in her signature golden dress.
Henry Daniel Mills is a fictional character in ABC's television series Once Upon a Time.
Henry is the boy Emma Swan gave up to adoption, and Regina Mills adopted him.
Jared S. Gilmore first portrayed Henry as a child and won the Young Artist Award for Best Performance in a TV Series -- Leading Young Actor in 2012.
For the seventh season, Andrew J. West took over the role of Henry as an adult and father to a ten-year-old girl named Lucy.
Captain Killian 'Hook' Jones is portrayed by Irish actor/musician Colin O'Donoghue.
Colin O'Donoghue became a series regular in the second season after making recurring appearances.
Captain Hook is based on the character from J.M. Barrie's play Peter and Wendy.
Robin of Locksley, later known as Robin Hood, is portrayed by British actor/singer Sean Maguire.
Sean Maguire became a series regular in the fifth season after recurring appearances in the third and fourth seasons.
Tom Ellis first played Robin in the second season, but scheduling conflicts prevented him from reprising the role.
Sean Maguire is the second actor to play Robin of Locksley in the series.
